name: Spectral Archers AP OLD
description: Ghostly soldiers wielding crossbows manifest within the towers that flank the gatehouse and rain bolts down upon intruders.
disable: DC 31 Intimidation (expert) to cow the archers into fleeing or DC 28 Religion (expert) to temporarily banish the spirits
reset: The haunt vanishes permanently if the graveknights are destroyed. Otherwise, it returns after 1 hour.

generalAbilities.name: Rain of Bolts
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature attacks the graveknights in area G1 or enters the castle

Effect The haunt makes a spectral bolt Strike against the triggering creature, then rolls initiative.

generalAbilities.name: Routine
generalAbilities.description: (1 action) The hazard fires one bolt at every creature in a 30-foot-by-30-foot area in front of the gate as 1 action. Because the spectral archers fire bolts continuously, the haunt can also use the Continuous Barrage free action (below) to fire bolts at each creature during that creature's turn.

generalAbilities.name: Continuous Barrage
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature in front of the gate finishes an action

Effect The haunt makes a spectral bolt Strike against the triggering creature.
